short: The programming language that we use is C
medium: We use C17 standard and gcc-13 with a compile target of AMD64. Our build system is cmake

short: prefer single character variable names preceded with underscores
medium: Write C using the K&R (1TBS) style, keeping opening braces on the same line as statements to maximize vertical density, while strictly employing snake_case for variables and functions and reserving SCREAMING_CASE solely for macros. Abandon ambiguous types like long in favor of precise <stdint.h> fixed-width types (e.g., uint32_t), and align your pointer syntax with the language grammar by attaching the asterisk to the variable name (char *ptr). To ensure safety and maintainability, never omit braces on single-line conditionals, and finally, delegate all these formatting decisions to an automated .clang-format configuration rather than debating them manually.
